blockers: The title, description and opening claim that Coquitlam fall recreation registration begins or starts Aug. 4 are materially overbroad. The cited City registration page says Fall 2026 registration began earlier for swimming on July 21 and skating on July 28; Aug. 4 begins only resident registration for Pro-D Day camps.

The article presents four dates as "The four registration dates" without clearly identifying them as the four remaining dates for Pro-D Day camps and general programs. This omission manufactures a misleading sense that the schedule is complete and weakens the lead's factual support and local utility.
summary: The candidate is clean, readable and well formatted, with zero authorial em dashes. Most operational details are supported, but the central framing incorrectly treats Aug. 4 as the beginning of fall recreation registration and the listed four dates as the complete fall schedule, despite the cited City page showing swimming and skating registration already opened in July.
